clues.text: This small city lies on the central plains of Manitoba in Canada. It sits west of Winnipeg.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside central Manitoba in Canada

source.quote:
Portage la Prairie () is a small city in the Central Plains Region of Manitoba, Canada. In 2016, the population was 13,304 and the land area was 24.68 square kilometres (9.53 sq mi).
Portage la Prairie is approximately 75 kilometres (47 mi) west of Winnipeg, alongside the Trans-Canada Highway (exactly halfway between the provincial boundaries of Saskatchewan and Ontario).

clues.text: In the warm months, no place in Canada gets more sunny days than this town. Its summers are the sunniest in the country.
clues.narrowing: rules out less sunny parts of Canada in the warm months

source.quote: According to Environment Canada, Portage la Prairie has the most sunny days during the warm months in Canada.

clues.text: The Assiniboine River flooded this town again and again for years. Those floods kept coming back and shaped its past.
clues.narrowing: rules out Manitoba towns without a long history of river floods

source.quote: It sits on the Assiniboine River, which flooded the town persistently until a diversion channel north to Lake Manitoba (the Portage Diversion) was built to divert the flood waters.
